format: preregistered calibration thresholds (spec section 8); values are authored only by the appointed method owner
rule: Numeric thresholds, confidence level, non-inferiority margin, multiplicity family, tie rule, coverage floor and the sample-size rationale belong to the appointed method owner. No method owner has been appointed yet, so every owner-owned numeric is null with status NEEDS_INPUT and ownerDecisionRef is null; missing values produce NEEDS_INPUT, never implicit defaults. Deriving any value from an observed winner is prohibited. Filling a value requires an immutable HumanDecision from an authenticated owner=user bound to the exact study+thresholds digest, and creates a new preregistration version; changing any value after the first recorded result requires a new preregistration, a new unused locked test and a full gate restart. Threshold selection may use the calibration split only.

non_inferiority_margin.direction: lower bound of the paired confidence interval above -delta

sample_size_rationale.structural_note: The spec (section 6) fixes a structural minimum of externally authored, independently labelled global cross-domain locked_test cases after source-family and semantic-template dedup; that spec-fixed structural minimum is recorded in the spec text, not authored here, and is never a statistical power guarantee.

steps: Step one: zero hard violations (hard gates above).
Step two: quality and coverage jointly pass and the lower bound of the paired confidence interval is above -delta (delta = non_inferiority_margin.delta once authored).
Step three: among eligible non-inferior candidates only, compare total cost.
Step four: compare latency under the frozen tie rule.
Step five: inconclusive outcomes resolve to HUMAN_REVIEW with no winner.
decision_rule.note: The step order is fixed by spec section 8 and preregistered here; every numeric parameter inside the steps stays NEEDS_INPUT until the method-owner HumanDecision exists. Trials with different model, budget or protocol are separate strata and never form a paired winner comparison.

notes: Abstain-all cannot win: precision without coverage is insufficient. A zero denominator, invalid labels, insufficient samples or violated independence are NOT_MEASURED, never 0% or 100%. No aggregate score may hide a hard failure or a safety-critical stratum failure. Locked-test unseal is a one-time audited HumanDecision by an authenticated owner=user over the exact study+thresholds+audit digest; split-secret custody stays with the label_custodian role.
